measurement.path: ISNS RC -> internal TPS 10-bit ADC -> addressed CRC SPI -> ISO7762F -> local IOL1 controller boundary

unimplemented_parent_obligations: Two field-derived VDD supplies, power-good and safe sequencing; never parallel TPS internal VDD regulators.
Local IOL1 controllers, 1ms accepted-frame timeout / <=2ms independent IWDG, reset, epoch enable and physical qualification; no constant CARD_EN/identity.
SPI/ADC CRC driver, configuration/readback limits/calibration, fault latching, bank current/thermal/load qualification and CLI/UI integration.
Protected field entry/bank bulk/surge clamp and output cable inductive-energy/EMC protection; TVS placeholder is deliberately not fitted.
Final connectors, return current/copper/thermal vias, clearance/isolation/stencil and PCB layout.
Actual output observations/status LEDs; unused LEDOUT pins do not prove observed output state.
